title: ProntoPC Action Envelope
description: The strict bounded operating contract for the repair-action catalogue. Owned by the prontopc-repair-engine Orb (it declares what its actions are and when they are admissible). Held at runtime by the Orchestrator, which KEYS each plan Umbilical to it: at the scan->plan seam the Orchestrator compiles the per-machine admissible action set from these preconditions x the live diagnostics, hands that narrowed set to whichever plan author is attached (cloud Orb or local-model Satellite), and validates the returned plan against this envelope before advancing to the consent phase. Every field a plan asserts about an action (risk, requires_restart, estimated_mb_recovered) is fixed HERE, not by the model. This is the structural guarantee that a small local model cannot emit an unsafe, inapplicable, or mislabelled action.

owner_orb.description: The Orb that owns the referents (the repair-engine).

diagnostics_ref.description: Which Orb output the predicate fields address (the diagnostics).

predicate_ops.description: The closed set of operators a precondition may use. Deliberately NOT Turing-complete: enough to express the 26 guards, no more.

plan_bounds.description: Whole-plan bounds the Orchestrator enforces after authorship, before consent.

max_actions.description: A plan may contain at most this many actions (kills runaway 'do everything' plans).

estimated_mb_recovered_cap.description: Rule: an action's estimated_mb_recovered is clamped to [0, measured cap from its mb source]; the plan total may never exceed measured reclaimable space.

subsumption.description: If the umbrella action is present, the listed member actions are dropped as redundant.

actions.description: One entry per catalogue action id. The keys MUST be exactly the prontopc-repair-engine catalogue (26).

risk.description: Fixed by contract. The model cannot set or downgrade it.

outcome.description: How the engine reports this action (freed=reclaims measured space; done=ran, no measured space; noted=report-only).

precondition.description: Predicate over the diagnostics. TRUE => the action is admissible on THIS machine and may enter the model's grammar; FALSE => the action is not selectable and is dropped if emitted.

field.description: Dotted path into diagnostics, e.g. update_leftovers.windows_old_present.

source.description: field=clamp to the named diagnostics measure; zero=not pre-measurable, force 0; none=no space dimension.

required_params.description: Params the engine needs (grounded in the handler). Missing => drop the action.

param_domains.description: Allowed values / source for required params.
